title: Page 2
content_zh:
高佻少女费明兰微微一笑，眼中带羞些许调皮与戏谑，说：「我就知道你们都是为『素心如雪』而来的，我也很想拿它出来给你们瞧瞧。只是……可惜啊可惜。」

「怎么了？」大红锦衣的少女挑了挑眉，有点不悦地问道：「难道你已经卖了吗？」

「知我者，淑荷也。」费明兰对大红锦衣少女露齿而笑。

姜淑荷皱了皱眉，道：「你就这么缺钱吗？说好了，今年最好的兰花要留给我的。」

更何况，这是一盆百年难遇的极品荷瓣素心兰，她的名字又叫淑荷，多么相配。身为会稽郡太守家的嫡长小姐，姜淑荷认为没有人比她更配得上那株极品兰花了。

因为景围的皇室喜爱兰花，据传当今薛皇后更是爱兰如痴，所以如今民间也以养兰为荣，会稽郡每年的兰花会都菲常热闹，每年选出的「花王」都能卖出天价。

今年的「花王」就是费明兰培植出的『素心如雪』。

姜淑荷道：「去年的『花王』卖了白银两万两，我再加五千，把『素心如雪』卖给我，如何？」

白银两万五千两，在达官贵人的眼中也算巨额了。

景国建国以来，历任皇帝都相当关注民生问题，极力调控物价，打压囤货扰乱市场的奸商，所以物价相当稳定。

一个四口的平民之家，一年的花销也粥不过就是白银二十两，这还算是过得相当宽松，每月都能吃鱼吃肉打打牙祭的。如果再俭省一点，一个这样的家庭连二十两都用不了。

白银两万两，足够那四口平民之家花销一千年，却有人一掷千金，不过是为了一盆兰花。

水红纱裙的少女姜淑梅，帮着姊姊道：「明兰，就算不看银子，看在咱们闺中姊妹面子上，也该把『素心如雪』留给我家啊。」

花厅中的诸多少女，都是出自官员或富商之家的千金小姐，其中又以姜家小姐们的身分为最高。

费明兰有些歉疚地笑笑，道：「并非是我不愿意留给你们，实在是被人预先定下了，只订金就交了两万两呢。」

按照商界约定俗成的规则，订金一般只占总额的一成，最多占半数，这样算起来那位买家至少会花四万两银子买这盆花了。

屋子或贵或富的千金小姐们也忍不住哗然。

「哇！好贵！」

「天哪！什么人这么大手笔？」

「咱们余姚县没有这种冤大头吧？这还是兰花吗？宝石都没这么贵！」

「明兰，是外地客人吗？」

费明兰摇头，说：「我也不太清楚，昨天才匆匆定了的，是一个管家模样的中年人来交的订令，说最迟三日，主家就会亲自来取花。听那人口音，说得像是京城里的官话。」

「喔！京城来的人！」

「京城？难怪出手这么阔绰」

「京城里藏龙卧虎，也不知是什么大人物定下的呢！」

小姐们恍然大悟，一副难怪如此的了然模样。

姜淑荷和姜溆梅脸色不好看，但也不敢贸然再讲什么难听的话了，她们不怕得罪费明兰，却怕不小心得罪了京城来的人。

她们虽然倨傲，却并不蠢，不会轻易为父亲招惹敌人。

气氛一时有点尴尬，织造家的小姐章茹芸笑着插话打圆场：「商家最重信誉，既然明兰已经先许了别家，咱们也不抢了，可是一饱眼福总是可以的吧？」

「对啊对啊，看看总行吧？」

费明兰也不想冷了众多小姐的心，但是……她有点难为地笑笑，说：「你们若是早来两日，我定然给你们看了，可是如今那买家要求保密，不许再给外人观赏。」

差淑梅也忍不住皱眉，「竟然如此霸道！」

费明兰苦笑道：「所以还请各位姊姊原谅，非是我不愿，实则不能。」

姜淑荷忽然道：「明兰，听说你家二小姐前些日子已经和刺史家公子订亲，可真有此事？」

一众少女立刻忘记了兰花，都留露出关注这件新消息的神情。

费明兰怔了一下，没想到姜淑荷这么突然转了话题，她想了想，这才微笑着点头承认，「是真的，妹妹已经许给刺史家二公子，不久就要大婚。」

一群十几岁的小姑娘互相扭头看看，交换着「居然真的如此」的奇妙限神。

姜淑梅才十三岁，心眼儿还没那么多，心直口快的问出了大家伙儿的心声，「明兰，先前不是给你说的亲吗？而且姊姊还未订亲，怎么就先轮到了妹妹？更何况刺史家二公子虽然不是嫡长子，但也是嫡次子，怎么也轮不到明蕙做他的正妻吧？」

费明兰的脸色沉了沉，但也心中无奈，毕竟姜淑梅所说的确是事实——在世人眼中，费家不过是一介不入流的商人，就算是余姚县首富又如何？还是无法和官家公子相匹配。

余姚县属于会稽郡，会稽郡又属于扬州，扬州最高军政长官就是扬州刺史，比会稽郡太守的级别足足高了四级，就算是姜家姊妹许配给刺史家，那也是高攀了，更别提费明兰这种商户女子了。

天下百姓并非人人平等，生下来就分了三六九等，那些戏子、娼妓、媒婆、盗窃、走卒等下九流且不提，在良民之中，土农工商，商人便属于最没有社会地位的那一类人。

费明兰的父亲费忠贵靠卖盐发家，会稽郡中余暨、余杭、余姚三县，大概都与盐业有关。

费忠贵是个天生的商人，眼光独到，手段俐落果断，短短二十年就成为余姚县最大的盐商。又因为他娶的妻子出自郑氏，乃当今皇上的母系一族，虽然只是个关系巯远的偏房幼女，但是费忠贵会巴结孝敬，不知如何与郑氏嫡系一脉攀上了关系，他也因此从普通商人一跃成为了皇商。

费明兰是因为有皇商之女的身分，才能与姜家姊妹、童茹芸这些官家小姐有了来往，成为闺中好友。

只是，费忠贵因为长年辛苦，年初正月里忽然就病逝了，费家少了当家支柱，一下子就陷入了各种麻烦之中。

再加上当今皇帝登基之后一直打压母系外戚，郑氏势力已经大不如前，费家最大的靠山不再牢靠，到得今年，甚至连皇商的地位也有些摇摇欲坠。

费明兰的兄长与妹妹都是庶出，她的母亲又是个不喜俗务的娇弱女子，费家的族亲也纷纷上门占便宜，费明兰父丧孝期还未结束，就己经一个头两个大，焦头烂额又无处诉说。

第1章(2)

费氏兰苑原本是因为费明兰的母亲喜爱兰花，费忠贵为妻子特意建的，费明兰从小浸浮其中，学得了一手高超的养兰本领，为讨母亲欢喜，她把兰苑越建越好，逐渐成了余姚县的名园。

短年花期，都有许多名流人士想进费氏兰苑观赏，费忠贵为了建立人脉关系，就开放了兰苑，短年的兰花花会于是成了惯例。

姜家姊妹看不惯费明兰进园收费的作风，更觉得她卖兰有辱斯文，却全然不知费明兰为了维持偌大家庭开销所付出的辛劳，以及想保住皇商资格所需要的巨额上供。

为了保住皇商的资格，费家不仅每年要给郑氏嫡系十万两白银，还要给扬州刺史、会稽郡太守、余姚县令各个层面的官员不同数额的孝敬。

如果皇商资格不保，那么费忠贵一辈子呕心沥血积攒下的家产，恐怕都会被别人抢去。

费忠贵有两个弟弟，一个嫡亲的二弟，一个庶出的三弟。但费忠贵却没有嫡子，只有费明兰这一个嫡女，还有一个婢女所生的庶长子费明德，以及费明德一母同胞的庶女费明蕙。
content_en:
Fei Minglan, a tall girl, smiled slightly, with a shy, mischievous and playful look in her eyes, and said, "I know you all came here for 'Su Xin Ru Xue', and I really want to show it to you. But... it's a pity, a pity."

"What's wrong?" The girl in bright red brocade clothes raised her eyebrows and asked a little displeasedly, "Have you already sold it?"

"The one who knows me is Shuhe." Fei Minglan grinned at the girl in red brocade.

Jiang Shuhe frowned and said, "Are you so short of money? We agreed that the best orchids this year will be left to me."

What's more, this is a pot of the best lotus petal orchid that is rare to find in a century. Her name is Shuhe, how suitable it is.As the eldest daughter of the prefect's family in Kuaiji County, Jiang Shuhe believed that no one was more worthy of that top-quality orchid than her.

Because the royal family in Jingwei loves orchids, and it is said that Queen Xue is even more obsessed with orchids, people now take pride in raising orchids. The annual orchid festival in Kuaiji County is very lively, and the "King of Flowers" selected every year can sell for a sky-high price.

This year's "Kao" is "Suxin Ruxue" bred by Fei Minglan.

Jiang Shuhe said: "Last year's 'Kao' sold for 20,000 taels of silver. I will add another 5,000 taels and sell 'Su Xin Ru Snow' to me. How about that?"

Twenty-five thousand taels of silver was considered a huge amount in the eyes of dignitaries.

Since the founding of Jingguo, successive emperors have paid great attention to people's livelihood issues, tried their best to regulate prices, and suppressed profiteers who hoarded goods and disrupted the market, so prices are quite stable.

A commoner family of four only had twenty taels of silver for a year. This was a fairly comfortable life, as they could eat fish, meat, and teeth every month.If we were more frugal, such a family would not even be able to afford twenty taels.

Twenty thousand taels of silver is enough for a commoner family of four to spend a thousand years, but some people spend a lot of money just for a pot of orchids.

Jiang Shumei, a girl in a bright red gauze skirt, helped her sister and said, "Minglan, even if you don't care about the money, for the sake of our sister's face, you should leave the 'Snow Heart' to my family."

Many of the girls in the flower hall are rich ladies from the families of officials or wealthy businessmen, among whom the girls of the Jiang family are the highest.

Fei Minglan smiled apologetically and said, "It's not that I don't want to leave it to you. It's actually been pre-arranged. I only paid a deposit of 20,000 taels."

According to the established rules in the business world, the deposit generally only accounts for 10% of the total amount, or at most half, so the buyer will spend at least 40,000 taels of silver to buy the flower.

The rich and wealthy ladies couldn't help but make an uproar.

"Wow! It's so expensive!"

"Oh my God! Who can be so generous?"

"We don't have such scammers in Yuyao County, right? Is this still an orchid? Gemstones are not that expensive!"

"Minglan, are you a guest from out of town?"

Fei Minglan shook his head and said, "I'm not sure. The order was hastily made yesterday by a middle-aged man who looked like a butler. He said that within three days at the latest, the master would come to pick up the flowers in person. From the accent of the man, it sounded like the official dialect of the capital city."

"Oh! People from the capital!"

"Capital City? No wonder the spending is so generous."

"There are hidden dragons and crouching tigers in the capital, and I don't know who the big shot decided it was!"

The ladies suddenly realized it, as if it was no wonder they were so aware.

Jiang Shuhe and Jiang Xumei looked ugly, but they did not dare to say any unpleasant words rashly. They were not afraid of offending Fei Minglan, but they were afraid of accidentally offending people from the capital.

Although they are arrogant, they are not stupid and will not easily provoke enemies for their father.

The atmosphere was a little awkward for a while, but Zhang Ruyun, a young lady from the weaving family, smiled and intervened to smooth things over: "Businessmen value credibility the most. Since Minglan has already made a promise to someone else, we won't take it away, but it's always okay to feast your eyes on it, right?"

"Yeah, yeah, let's take a look at the head office, right?"

Fei Minglan didn't want to upset the hearts of many young ladies, but...she smiled a little embarrassedly and said, "If you had come two days earlier, I would have shown it to you, but now the buyer requires it to be kept secret and is not allowed to be viewed by outsiders."

Cha Shumei couldn't help but frown, "How domineering!"

Fei Minglan smiled bitterly and said, "So I ask you, sisters, to forgive me. It's not because I don't want to, but I actually can't."

Jiang Shuhe suddenly said: "Minglan, I heard that the second young lady of your family was engaged to the governor's son a few days ago. Is this true?"

All the girls immediately forgot about Orchid, and all looked concerned about this new news.

Fei Minglan was stunned for a moment. She didn't expect Jiang Shuhe to change the topic so suddenly. She thought for a while, then nodded and admitted with a smile, "It's true. My sister has been promised to the second son of the governor's family and will get married soon."

A group of teenage girls turned to look at each other, exchanging miraculous thoughts about "It's really like this."

Jiang Shumei was only thirteen years old, and she didn't have that much in mind. She asked outright what everyone was thinking, "Minglan, wasn't it promised to you earlier? And the elder sister has not yet been engaged, so why did it come to the younger sister first? What's more, although the second son of the governor's family is not the eldest son, he is also the second son. Why can't Minghui be his wife?"

Fei Minglan's face darkened, but she felt helpless. After all, what Jiang Shumei said was indeed true - in the eyes of the world, the Fei family was just a low-level businessman, so what if they were the richest man in Yuyao County?Still can't match the official son.

Yuyao County belongs to Kuaiji County, and Kuaiji County belongs to Yangzhou. The highest military and political officer in Yangzhou is the governor of Yangzhou, which is four levels higher than the prefect of Kuaiji County. Even if the Jiang sisters are betrothed to the governor's family, it is still a high ranking, let alone a merchant woman like Fei Minglan.

Not all people in the world are equal. They are divided into three, six or nine classes at birth, not to mention those actors, prostitutes, matchmakers, thieves, pawns and other low-ranking people. Among good people, farmers, farmers, merchants, and merchants belong to the category of people with the least social status.

Fei Minglan's father, Fei Zhonggui, made his fortune by selling salt. The three counties of Yuji, Yuhang and Yuyao in Kuaiji County are probably all related to the salt industry.

Fei Zhonggui was a natural businessman with unique vision and decisive methods. In just twenty years, he became the largest salt merchant in Yuyao County.And because the wife he married was from the Zheng family, a maternal family of the current emperor, although she was just a distant daughter, Fei Zhonggui was fawning and filial, and somehow managed to establish a relationship with the direct line of the Zheng family. As a result, he jumped from an ordinary businessman to an imperial businessman.

It was because of her status as the daughter of an imperial merchant that Fei Minglan got in touch with the Jiang sisters, Tong Ruyun and other official ladies and became close friends.

However, Fei Zhonggui suddenly died of illness in the first month of the year due to years of hard work. The Fei family was without a pillar of support and suddenly fell into all kinds of troubles.

Coupled with the fact that the current emperor has been suppressing his maternal relatives since he ascended the throne, the power of the Zheng family has been greatly reduced. The Fei family's biggest backer is no longer reliable. This year, even the status of the imperial merchants is somewhat shaky.

Fei Minglan's brother and sister were both concubines, and her mother was a delicate woman who didn't like worldly affairs. The Fei family's relatives also came to take advantage of her. Fei Minglan's father's mourning period had not yet ended, and he had already lost one head and two children. He was so worried and had nowhere to talk.

Chapter 1(2)

Fei's Orchid Garden was originally built by Fei Zhonggui for his wife because Fei Minglan's mother loved orchids. Fei Minglan was immersed in it since she was a child and learned the superb skills of raising orchids. In order to please her mother, she built the Orchid Garden better and better, and gradually became a famous garden in Yuyao County.

During the short-term flowering period, many celebrities wanted to visit Fei's Orchid Garden. In order to build connections, Fei Zhonggui opened the orchid garden, and short-term orchid flower festivals became a routine.

The Jiang sisters couldn't stand Fei Minglan's way of charging fees to enter the garden, and felt that it was insulting to her to sell orchids, but they had no idea of ​​the hard work Fei Minglan had put in to maintain the expenses of such a large family, and the huge amount of donations required to keep her qualifications as an imperial merchant.

In order to maintain their status as imperial merchants, the Fei family not only paid 100,000 taels of silver to direct descendants of the Zheng family every year, but also paid varying amounts of tribute to officials at all levels, including the governor of Yangzhou, the prefect of Kuaiji County, and the magistrate of Yuyao County.

If the qualifications of an imperial merchant are not guaranteed, then Fei Zhonggui's family property, which he has worked hard to accumulate throughout his life, may be snatched away by others.

Fei Zhonggui had two younger brothers, a second brother who was his biological brother, and a third brother who was a concubine.But Fei Zhonggui had no legitimate children. He only had one legitimate daughter, Fei Minglan, his eldest son Fei Mingde, who was born by a maidservant, and Fei Minghui, a concubine who was a compatriot of Fei Mingde's mother.
